testResults.name: results-store-and-lake-adapters
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/harness/results/test_store.py tests/lake/storage/test_azure_readable.py tests/lake/catalog/test_run_repository.py tests/lake/results/test_backtest_results_integration.py
testResults.result: 40 passed + 1 credential-guarded skip: ReadableBlobStore port and AzureReadableBlobStore (read/list_prefix/delete_prefix over ContainerClient), lake RunRecord/RunRepository with memory and Azure Table adapters, LakeRunCatalogRepository re-pointing the harness store to lake ports with all 23 pre-existing store tests green, credential-guarded integration test network-free by default

testResults.name: repository-wide-quality-gates
testResults.result: Repository-wide gates and the 1299-test pytest suite passed after wave integration

limitations: RunStatus (harness) deliberately not unified with lake JobState; RunState (lake) maps losslessly for row storage — documented in both docstrings
AzureTableRunRepository.delete does get-then-delete because the SDK delete_entity succeeds silently on missing rows
